```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import json
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, display

df = pd.read_csv("C:/Users/Alex/Documents/GitHub/Portfolio/Data/Olympics.csv")

# Readable country labels. Team is messy (1,184 values, with suffixes like "France-1"),
# so take the most common cleaned Team name for each NOC code.
df["TeamClean"] = df["Team"].str.replace(r"-\d+$", "", regex=True)
noc_name = df.groupby("NOC")["TeamClean"].agg(lambda s: s.mode().iat[0])

med = df[df.Medal.notna()].copy()
med["Country"] = med.NOC.map(noc_name)

# A team medal is stored once per athlete, so counting rows overcounts.
# Collapsing to distinct Event x Year x Season x Medal gives the real medal count.
ev = med.drop_duplicates(["NOC", "Year", "Season", "Event", "Medal"])

medal_ct = ev.groupby(["NOC", "Country", "Year", "Season"]).size().rename("medals")
athlete_ct = med.groupby(["NOC", "Country", "Year", "Season"]).size().rename("athlete_medals")
gold_ct = (ev[ev.Medal == "Gold"]
           .groupby(["NOC", "Country", "Year", "Season"]).size().rename("gold"))

medals = (pd.concat([medal_ct, athlete_ct, gold_ct], axis=1)
            .fillna(0).astype({"gold": int}).reset_index())

games = (df.groupby(["Year", "Season"])
           .agg(athletes=("ID", "nunique"), sports=("Sport", "nunique"),
                events=("Event", "nunique"), nations=("NOC", "nunique"))
           .reset_index())

df["decade"] = (df.Year // 10) * 10
physique = (df.dropna(subset=["Height", "Weight"])
              .groupby(["Sport", "decade", "Season"])
              .agg(height=("Height", "mean"), weight=("Weight", "mean"), n=("ID", "size"))
              .reset_index())
physique = physique[physique.n >= 30].round({"height": 1, "weight": 1})

payload = {
    "medals": json.loads(medals.to_json(orient="records")),
    "games": json.loads(games.to_json(orient="records")),
    "physique": json.loads(physique.to_json(orient="records")),
}
display(HTML("<script>window.OLY = " + json.dumps(payload) + ";</script>"))
```

```{=html}
<!-- Quarto's jupyter engine loads RequireJS, and a UMD bundle that sees define.amd
     registers itself as an AMD module instead of setting a global. Park define
     across these two tags so d3 and Plot attach to window, then restore it. -->
<script>window.__amdDefine = window.define; window.define = undefined;</script>
<script src="libs/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="libs/plot.umd.min.js"></script>
<script>window.define = window.__amdDefine; delete window.__amdDefine;</script>
<script>
(function () {
  var data = window.OLY;
  var medals = data.medals, games = data.games, physique = data.physique;

  var elMin = document.getElementById("oly-min");
  var elMax = document.getElementById("oly-max");
  var elMinLab = document.getElementById("oly-min-lab");
  var elMaxLab = document.getElementById("oly-max-lab");
  var elCountries = document.getElementById("oly-countries");

  // Seed the country list, ordered by all-time medals.
  var totals = d3.rollups(medals, function (v) { return d3.sum(v, function (d) { return d.medals; }); },
                          function (d) { return d.Country; })
                 .sort(function (a, b) { return b[1] - a[1]; });
  totals.forEach(function (t, i) {
    var o = document.createElement("option");
    o.value = t[0]; o.textContent = t[0] + " (" + t[1] + ")";
    if (i < 5) o.selected = true;
    elCountries.appendChild(o);
  });

  function state() {
    var season = document.querySelector("input[name=oly-season]:checked").value;
    var lo = +elMin.value, hi = +elMax.value;
    if (lo > hi) { var t = lo; lo = hi; hi = t; }
    var picked = Array.prototype.slice.call(elCountries.selectedOptions)
                      .map(function (o) { return o.value; });
    return { season: season, lo: lo, hi: hi, picked: picked };
  }

  function seasonOk(d, s) { return s === "Both" ? true : d.Season === s; }

  function draw() {
    var st = state();
    elMinLab.textContent = st.lo;
    elMaxLab.textContent = st.hi;

    var med = medals.filter(function (d) {
      return seasonOk(d, st.season) && d.Year >= st.lo && d.Year <= st.hi;
    });
    var gam = games.filter(function (d) {
      return seasonOk(d, st.season) && d.Year >= st.lo && d.Year <= st.hi;
    });
    var phy = physique.filter(function (d) {
      return seasonOk(d, st.season) && d.decade >= st.lo - 9 && d.decade <= st.hi;
    });

    document.getElementById("oly-medals").textContent =
      d3.format(",")(d3.sum(med, function (d) { return d.medals; }));
    document.getElementById("oly-nations").textContent =
      new Set(med.map(function (d) { return d.NOC; })).size;
    document.getElementById("oly-sports").textContent =
      gam.length ? d3.max(gam, function (d) { return d.sports; }) : 0;
    document.getElementById("oly-games").textContent = gam.length;

    var sel = med.filter(function (d) { return st.picked.indexOf(d.Country) >= 0; });

    render("oly-trend", sel.length ? Plot.plot({
      marginLeft: 48, marginBottom: 34, height: 300, width: 620,
      x: { label: "Year", tickFormat: "d", grid: true },
      y: { label: "Medals", grid: true },
      color: { legend: true, scheme: "Tableau10" },
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleY([0]),
        Plot.line(sel, { x: "Year", y: "medals", stroke: "Country", strokeWidth: 2,
                         curve: "monotone-x", sort: { channel: "x" } }),
        Plot.dot(sel, { x: "Year", y: "medals", fill: "Country", r: 3,
                        channels: { Gold: "gold" }, tip: true })
      ]
    }) : null, "Select at least one country.");

    var top = d3.rollups(med, function (v) { return d3.sum(v, function (d) { return d.medals; }); },
                         function (d) { return d.Country; })
                .sort(function (a, b) { return b[1] - a[1]; })
                .slice(0, 12)
                .map(function (d) { return { Country: d[0], medals: d[1] }; });

    render("oly-rank", top.length ? Plot.plot({
      marginLeft: 122, marginBottom: 34, height: 300, width: 430,
      x: { label: "Medals", grid: true },
      y: { label: null },
      marks: [
        Plot.barX(top, { x: "medals", y: "Country", fill: "#3498db",
                         sort: { y: "-x" }, tip: true }),
        Plot.ruleX([0])
      ]
    }) : null, "No medals in this range.");

    render("oly-phys", phy.length ? Plot.plot({
      marginLeft: 48, marginBottom: 36, height: 300, width: 620,
      x: { label: "Mean weight (kg)", grid: true },
      y: { label: "Mean height (cm)", grid: true },
      color: { legend: true, label: "Decade", scheme: "Viridis" },
      marks: [
        Plot.dot(phy, { x: "weight", y: "height", fill: "decade", r: 4, fillOpacity: .85,
                        channels: { Sport: "Sport", Athletes: "n" }, tip: true })
      ]
    }) : null, "No height or weight data in this range.");

    var byYear = d3.rollups(gam, function (v) { return d3.sum(v, function (d) { return d.athletes; }); },
                            function (d) { return d.Year; })
                   .sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; })
                   .map(function (d) { return { Year: d[0], athletes: d[1] }; });

    render("oly-size", byYear.length ? Plot.plot({
      marginLeft: 52, marginBottom: 34, height: 300, width: 430,
      x: { label: "Year", tickFormat: "d", grid: true },
      y: { label: "Athletes", grid: true },
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleY([0]),
        Plot.areaY(byYear, { x: "Year", y: "athletes", fill: "#3498db",
                             fillOpacity: .3, curve: "monotone-x" }),
        Plot.line(byYear, { x: "Year", y: "athletes", stroke: "#2c3e50",
                            strokeWidth: 2, curve: "monotone-x", tip: true })
      ]
    }) : null, "No Games in this range.");
  }

  function render(id, node, emptyMsg) {
    var host = document.getElementById(id);
    host.innerHTML = "";
    if (node) host.appendChild(node);
    else host.innerHTML = '<div class="oly-empty">' + emptyMsg + "</div>";
  }

  ["change", "input"].forEach(function (evt) {
    document.querySelectorAll("input[name=oly-season]").forEach(function (r) {
      r.addEventListener(evt, draw);
    });
    elMin.addEventListener(evt, draw);
    elMax.addEventListener(evt, draw);
    elCountries.addEventListener(evt, draw);
  });

  draw();
})();
</script>
```

## How this page works

The Olympic history file has 271,116 rows and is 36 MB, which is far too large to send to a
browser. A Python step reads it when the site is built and reduces it to three small tables:
medals by country and Games, participation by Games, and average athlete build by sport and
decade. Those tables total about 270 KB and are embedded directly in this page, so every
filter above runs locally with nothing to fetch and no server involved.

One counting decision is worth stating plainly. This dataset records a medal once per
athlete, so a basketball gold appears twelve times. Counting rows would badly overstate team
sports, so the page counts distinct events instead. The United States took 121 medals at Rio
2016 by that measure, shared among 264 athletes.

The charts are drawn with Observable Plot, and both it and D3 are stored alongside this page
rather than loaded from a content delivery network. The whole dashboard is a static file. It
costs nothing to host and has no dependency that can disappear.
